storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP ClientClub Downloader makes it easy to save videos from GoHighLevel and ClientClub client portals.

How it works: Navigate to any lesson or page in your ClientClub portal, play the video, and click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension automatically detects the portal environment and identifies the embedded video platform, shows available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles Loom recordings, Vimeo embeds, Wistia players, YouTube videos, and GoHighLevel native media automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized ClientClub Downloader subfolder.

Key features:
- Automatic ClientClub/GoHighLevel portal detection
- Multi-platform support: Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, YouTube, GoHighLevel native video
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Concurrent download support (up to 3 simultaneous downloads)
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Dark-themed UI with blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to your ClientClub/GoHighLevel portal and play a video
3. Click the extension icon
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: What portals does this work with?
faq.answer: Any GoHighLevel or ClientClub-powered client portal. The extension detects the portal environment automatically using DOM markers like x-cp-build-version and clientportal-siteCustomHeader.

faq.question: What video platforms are supported?
faq.answer: Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, YouTube embeds, and GoHighLevel native video. Each platform has a dedicated detector and handler for reliable extraction.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any lesson or page in your ClientClub portal and press play on the video. Then click the extension icon or right-click and select "Download ClientClub Video."

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the embedded platform. Options depend on what the video host provides — typically multiple resolutions up to 1080p or higher.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a ClientClub Downloader subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: Can I download multiple videos at once?
faq.answer: Yes — the extension supports up to 3 concurrent downloads with individual progress tracking.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Skool or Circle?
faq.answer: No — Skool and Circle have their own dedicated SERP downloader extensions. This extension is specifically for GoHighLevel/ClientClub portals.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure you are on a GoHighLevel/ClientClub portal page. Press play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before detection works. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
